footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $150M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 3.0% to $14.3B in 2025. Gross margin was 35.1%, versus 38.2% a year earlier, and the company had an operating loss of $2.7B, versus operating income of $10.1M.
The net loss widened to $3.5B, or −$3.00 per share, from $634M. Operating cash flow was $2.3B and free cash flow $1.9B, versus $2.0B; Viatris returned $500M through buybacks.
sources: Viatris Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
